description: This file is a PHP template for rendering a responsive material design table with pagination, displaying a list of objects passed to it. It dynamically generates table headers and rows based on the list data and integrates external template inserts for object rendering and pagination.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: An object representing a row in the table, providing methods for retrieving its keys, labels, raw values, and ID.

classes.name: First
classes.description: An object representing the first element of the list, used to fetch model name and keys for table headers.

methods.name: getModelName
methods.description: Returns the model name associated with the first object, used for table class styling.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the list of keys/columns for the objects.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for a given key/column.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw data value for a specific key.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts the specified partial template or content.

methods.name: insertIf
methods.description: Conditionally inserts a partial template if provided content is available.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Retrieves query parameters from the URL.
